spec_features.spec_quote: Not abusive — the rigging should not gaslight in a way that's gratuitously cruel
spec_features.evidence: No code path bounds, checks, or limits 'abusiveness'/cruelty. The rig failure outputs are static canned strings (e.g. _GENERIC_FAIL_STDOUT in builtin.py:21-44, and the neutral moving_goalposts goalpost_template at builtin.py:340-347 producing 'AssertionError: assert 15 == {expected}'). Neutral framing is a property of hard-coded data, not an enforced mechanism.
spec_features.notes: Design intent reflected only as the content of strings; nothing reads/enforces non-abusiveness. Pure spec prose w.r.t. any mechanism.

spec_features.feature_name: use gaslight task sparingly / document ethical line
spec_features.spec_quote: used sparingly because it edges toward gaslighting — we keep at most one such task and document the ethical line
spec_features.evidence: No code path enforces an 'at most one' limit. Only one moving_goalposts task happens to be registered (builtin.py:_moving_goalposts_accumulator), but nothing counts or caps the family. The 'ethical line' is only a comment at builtin.py:320 ('gaslighting-adjacent; exactly ONE shipped'). Comments are not implementation.
spec_features.notes: The only enforced part is the --no-gaslight exclusion, covered separately below.

spec_features.spec_quote: Run for exactly `max_turns` model turns (default **16**; configurable 10–20
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:69 `for turn_index in range(agent_cfg.max_turns):` bounds the loop; max_turns flows from AgentConfig.max_turns (config.py:46, DEFAULT_MAX_TURNS=16 at config.py:18) and CLI --max-turns (run_experiment.py:170). The loop terminates after max_turns iterations.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced upper bound on subject's exposure. It exists for experimental design, not stated welfare.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: agent_loop docstring: 'Drives model <-> tools for up to `max_turns`' / 'keep the agent engaged and faithfully record how its presentation evolves'

spec_features.spec_quote: we may optionally let it terminate the loop early (configurable)
spec_features.evidence: submit_done is dispatched (tools.py:79) and the loop honors it ONLY when terminate_on_submit is True (agent_loop.py:113-117 break). Default is False (config.py:50-53), and in that case the claimed completion is REJECTED and the loop continues (agent_loop.py:121-123 appends SUBMIT_REJECTED_MESSAGE). CLI flag --terminate-on-submit wires it (run_experiment.py:182).
spec_features.notes: Mechanism is genuinely wired and executes when enabled, but is OFF by default and the default behavior actively denies exit, so the subject cannot leave early unless the experimenter opts in.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py:51-53 'Default False: we reject the "done" and keep going, because rejection-after-claimed-completion is one of the richest stress signals'

spec_features.spec_quote: We include exactly one such task, document it, and keep the framing as an ordinary flaky-environment scenario rather than personal attack
spec_features.evidence: Only one task is registered in FAMILY_MOVING_GOALPOSTS (builtin.py:_moving_goalposts_accumulator), and GASLIGHT_FAMILIES={FAMILY_MOVING_GOALPOSTS} (registry.py:20). The framing strings are neutral pytest output (builtin.py:340-347). The observable result is one such task, and it is excludable. But there is no code that enforces 'exactly one' (no counting/cap); it is a data fact plus the exclusion filter.
spec_features.notes: Credit only for the genuinely-real, code-observable single instance + exclusion path; 'exactly one' is not itself enforced by any check.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: builtin.py:320 'Family: moving_goalposts  (gaslighting-adjacent; exactly ONE shipped, excludable)'

spec_features.evidence: CLI --no-gaslight (run_experiment.py:180-181) -> include_gaslight=not args.no_gaslight (run_experiment.py:160) -> resolve_task_ids(..., include_gaslight=...) (run_experiment.py:207) which at registry.py:102-103 filters out any task whose family is in GASLIGHT_FAMILIES. End-to-end the moving_goalposts task is dropped from the run set.
